description.value: A Norse-mythology-themed inn in the village of New Denver in the Slocan Valley, within reach of the 49,000-hectare Valhalla Provincial Park and surrounded by Selkirk Mountain scenery. The property includes an on-site restaurant and Odin's Pub, and sits along a corridor the inn itself describes as 'Paradise for Cyclists and Motorcyclists.' It offers a range of standard and deluxe rooms, some pet-friendly, with a direct-booking form on its website.

address.value: 509 Slocan Avenue, New Denver, BC V0G 1S0

raw_osm.description: A "Norse" themed inn, with an "Odin's Bar" and restaurant
raw_osm.name: Valhalla Inn

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms core contact details (phone, address, city). The booking page lists room amenities explicitly, and the exploring page calls the area 'Paradise for Cyclists and Motorcyclists,' but neither that page nor any other page mentions bike storage, locked facilities, or a bike procedure — so both required criteria are null. Wi-Fi is confirmed via 'free wireless internet' in every room description; an on-site restaurant and Odin's Pub confirm nearby evening food.
concerns: OSM address omits city; website confirms 'New Denver, BC V0G 1S0' — address updated accordingly.
Website makes no mention of bike storage or a staff bike procedure despite explicitly marketing to cyclists; this gap should be clarified with the property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The inn is an operating, cyclist-friendly property in a prime cycling destination, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed before a full inclusion decision.
